purpose: Form RSC-5 is used to issue notice and directions by the National Company Law Tribunal regarding the reduction of share capital.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Within fifteen days of submission of the application under rule 2, the Tribunal shall give notice or direct that notice be given.
steps: The Tribunal gives notice or directs that notice be given to the Central Government, Registrar of Companies, Securities and Exchange Board of India, and creditors.
Notices are sent to each creditor whose name is entered in the list of creditors.
Notice is published in an English newspaper, a vernacular language newspaper, and uploaded on the company website.
Creditors file objections in the Tribunal within three months from the date of publication.
checklist: Details of the proposed reduction of share capital
Details of the debt or contingent debt or claim for each creditor
watch: Objections must be filed in the Tribunal within three months from the date of publication of the notice with a copy served on the company.
